headline: Northern Fronts Reel Under Fierce Clashes as Dead Lands Stir
war_summary: Combat along Callahan's Passage cooled markedly following its earlier storm of casualties, giving way to fierce engagements elsewhere along the front. Nevish Line emerged as the day's sharpest battleground, recording twelve strategic base turnovers in the past two hours amidst accelerating losses around Princefal, Blackcoat Way, and Grief Mother. Weathered Expanse maintained an equally furious tempo, logging seven base transitions over the same span as contested positions at Crow's Nest, Shattered Advance, and Wightwalk left four bases in ruin. Fighting in the Dead Lands rekindled abruptly, marked by a sudden surge in Warden casualties exceeding twelve hundred in the latest hour alone. Along Kuura Strand, front-line exchanges quieted into a tentative lull after thirty-eight structural shifts earlier in the day. Farther east, Linn of Mercy and Marban Hollow experienced mounting skirmish casualties despite seeing no fresh territorial changes since midday, while backline southern sectors remain entirely settled under Colonial control.
